summary: Lazy-initializes the CRT command-line singleton when dword_8D5A4C is zero, then skips past the leading command-line token (either a quoted or an unquoted token) and returns a pointer to the first argument after the executable name, trimmed of leading whitespace.

operations.description: If dword_8D5A4C (init guard flag) is zero, the command-line singleton has not been initialized yet.
Call LazyInitSingletonWithFlagGuard_7218 to build the command-line singleton.
v0 = (_BYTE *)dword_8D5A44 takes the current command-line cursor pointer.
If *(_BYTE *)dword_8D5A44 != 34, the leading token is unquoted and is handled by the whitespace-skip loop.
Unquoted token path: advance v0 while *v0 > 0x20 to skip past the token until a whitespace character or terminator.
Quoted token path: advance v0 reading v1 = *v0 until v1 == 34 (closing quote) or v1 is zero; when ThreeArgCallWrapper(v1) is true the following character is escaped and skipped by an extra ++v0.
After a quoted token, if *v0 != 34 fall through to the whitespace trim; otherwise consume the closing quote with ++v0.
Trim trailing whitespace: advance v0 while *v0 is non-zero and *v0 <= 0x20.
Return v0, the pointer to the first argument after the executable name.
